full_text.rule: Require repeated/spread R&I and geopolitical evidence in the available full text.

abstract_only.rule: Require EU + R&I + geopolitics to be substantively connected; do not require document sections that are unavailable.

metadata_only.rule: Insufficient text is not evidence of irrelevance; attempt abstract/full-text recovery.

eu_anchor_context_rule: Bare EU is not a European Union anchor when the document explicitly defines EU as another abbreviation (for example environmental uncertainty).
matrix_evidence_rule: For vetted Strand A evidence, classify row and independence/competitiveness directions from the source-backed title/summary/relevance evidence; direction keywords support the rubric but are not a second gate. Weak signals remain event/mechanism gated.
priority_people_rule: Curated researchers receive extra discovery attention inside the ordinary scholarly rotation. Their works are not labelled, separated, or displayed differently, and admission criteria are unchanged.
priority_people_fallback_rule: If exact-author discovery yields nothing, use affiliation + topic hints for a bounded contextual scholarly query. Results from this fallback are processed exactly like all other scholarly discoveries and may belong to any researcher.
english_evidence_rule: Public A/B evidence must be an English-language publication. Explicit foreign-language metadata, a non-English publication title, or meaningful non-Latin source prose rejects the record. An English abstract does not rescue a foreign-language publication; no translation is used for admission.
eu_ri_geopolitics_core_rule: Strand A requires source-supported EU/European scope + substantive R&I + geopolitical/economic-security relevance. The radar may summarize source evidence but may not manufacture Europe relevance by attaching an inferred external-shock bridge.
material_external_shock_rule: Inference-only external-shock admission is disabled. A non-EU development can enter only when the source itself explicitly establishes a substantive effect on EU/European R&I in geopolitical/economic-security terms; it then passes through the normal direct-EU evidence route.
reader_point_subject_rule: Every reader-facing finding and why-it-matters point must start with an explicit actor, system or topic. Do not start with vague references such as this, these, those, it, they, such, the study, the paper, the findings or the developments.
reader_point_sentence_rule: Reader-facing points must be complete sentences of at most 120 characters. Never hard-cut a sentence and never use ellipses to force the limit.
preferred_q1_journals_note: Discovery preference only. Shortlist verified against SCImago SJR 2024 Q1 listings; quartiles can change. Never an admission requirement.
source_attention_policy: Prefer high-quality journal articles and EU primary reports in discovery. Core EU sources use bounded source-specific publication hubs when sitemap discovery is weak. Missing scholarly text is rescued by metadata priority before admission. Keep broad rotation and unchanged substantive admission gates.
matrix_balance_policy: Matrix coverage uses a source-supported semantic contract for every cell, including reviewed adjudications. Sparse cells get extra discovery attention across multiple plausible mechanisms; no cell is filled to satisfy a quota.
matrix_balance_rotation_rule: Coverage is recalculated every scan and during depth waves. Sparse cells receive extra searches for distinct causal mechanisms (talent, access, scale, rules) while every placement must evidence the row plus both control/dependence and performance directions.

reader_language_profiles.matrix_priorities: simple analytical language; simpler than main radar
reader_language_profiles.excel_export: technical audit language and classifier detail

foresight_author_followup_rule: Authors already evidenced by admitted Strand-B foresight/method publications receive a bounded rotating exact-author check in OpenAlex/Crossref. Their later works must pass the ordinary A/B gates; no institution or domain receives a permanent lane.
weak_signal_evidence_followup_rule: An interesting low-evidence C item that cites or points to research/report/publication evidence may trigger bounded link-following and scholarly search. Any stronger source is admitted separately through the ordinary A/B gates; the C item itself remains low evidence.
foresight_expert_seed_rule: Named people may receive bounded person-centric discovery attention; no domain or institution is privileged, and every discovered item must pass the ordinary EU R&I A/B gates.
citation_snowball_pinned_seed_titles: The Global Landscape of National AI Strategies
phrase_ontology_policy: Strand A/B phrases support conservative discovery and linkage. Strand C phrases are retrieval/re-ranking only and never admit a weak signal without a substantive Strand-A anchor and a distinct new point. Established or mature EU-official institutional material belongs in A if it passes A; only genuinely provisional/experimental/uncertain official developments may enter C.
source_family_rotation_rule: Every ordinary scan gives institutional/EU sources and scholarly journal collectors concurrent first-class time slices. Each family keeps independent persisted cursors; no output quota is imposed.
topic_rotation_rule: The Strand-A scholarly query bank is interleaved by coarse topic family before persistent rotation, and Matrix-gap/finding-context/method lanes are round-robin interleaved into the executed prefix.
reader_quality_ranking_rule: After substantive admission/Matrix placement, reader surfaces rank findings with source merit from source_merit.js (authority + EU relevance + evidence strength + author transparency) as a material part of ordering, never as an admission shortcut.
